reproducibility.interpretation: Same seed, same data, same config. The prompted baseline reproduced BIT-IDENTICALLY across the same two sessions, which isolates the source: the evaluation harness is exactly deterministic, and all 0.0039 of the spread comes from training (GPU kernel selection and fp16 reduction order). So the noise floor applies when comparing two TRAINING runs; a fixed adapter scored twice gives the same number.

notes: Validation loss bottomed at epoch 2 in all three training runs, under two different loss definitions. 3 epochs is one too many; set epochs=2 for the remaining adapters and save ~9 min each.
The Colab cell that produced these numbers self-labelled 'adapter-epoch3'. That tag is hardcoded in an older pasted cell and is wrong: the weights are the epoch-2 best checkpoint.
